source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 18 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Iulian»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Ιουλιανός «ὁ ἐν τῷ Εὐφράτῃ ποταμῷ»»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is the same ascetic of the Euphrates: the child of a poor family, unlettered, famous while still a young monk, his cell on the banks of the river, a season of asceticism on Sinai and a return to the river, a comfort to many under Julian the Apostate, and praised by Chrysostom as having a name brighter than a king's; he died in peace. `dates` **are** proposed and only because the page states a century for his life outright — «έζησε τον 4ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» — as a `floruit` and nothing more. The page prints no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Παιδί φτωχής οικογένειας ο Όσιος Ιουλιανός, έζησε τον 4ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» The page gives no year of birth or of death.
